title: Research funding and fellowships
summary: This Bank of England page describes administrative details of the Houblon-Norman and George Fellowships, which provide funding for external researchers to conduct studies at the Bank. The fellowships award per diem allowances up to £120,000 annually to support research on economic or financial topics. Applications for 2026/27 are closed with the next cycle opening autumn 2026.
key_points: Houblon-Norman Fellowship established 1944; George Fellowship established 2003
Fellowships range from one month to one year duration
Awards are per diem allowances for subsistence costs, not salary replacement
Current trustees include Clare Lombardelli (Chair), Anne Glover, and Nathanaël Benjamin
Advisory committee includes Professor Julia Black (Chair), Huw Pill, and Professor Alan Taylor
